cues.text: Storage and kitchen open from the east hall; the copier room connects through storage.
Door fits the first lift opening: ninety centimetres wide and 2.1 metres high.
Move Copy repeats that door. Use matching floor-grid references in the clear open space.
The meeting room gets a wider entrance from the north open space.
The east and west sides are plain walls, one unit thick: thirty centimetres, with no windows.
Label axes A to H and rows one to four. Each bay is six metres square.
Mark the lift and stair enclosures FR90, and the side halls FR30, following the plan.
Keep the north and south bands as open offices, connected around this central service core.
Show Objects and lock the labels. On a quarter-unit grid, build two mullions with no top rail.
Join their inner corners with a closed Polyline. The glazing fills the full height.
Make Object, and Edit Prototype. This panel is one and a half metres wide.
Add a Multiply Linear hotspot, attach the panel, and pick a reference one panel width back.
Nice. Drag the instance handle across the frontage: twenty-eight glazed panels.
Move the assembled curtain wall onto the south edge, using its corner and a helper.
Copy the wall to the north edge. Both facades share one definition. Then unlock the labels.
For the ceiling, make one reusable sixty centimetre square panel in the open office zone.
Edit Prototype. A volumetric array hotspot repeats the panel in both plan directions.
Drag the instance handle to form two rows of twenty panels, then lift the assembly on a helper.
Good. Seven by three structural bays, four lifts, two staircases and open offices around one central core.
The partial ceiling leaves the layout visible. The structural and facade grids remain hotspot-driven.
